reasoning_summary: Selected features prioritize stable, interpretable credit risk signals with low missingness and broad coverage across key semantic groups: credit score, indebtedness, delinquency, utilization, income capacity, and customer history. Features with high missingness or operational brittleness were excluded. Redundancy was controlled by preferring representative aggregates and avoiding near-duplicates unless they add distinct information. Flags indicating missingness or rare events were generally excluded unless they provide stable, interpretable signals. Categorical bands and key demographic or application variables were included to ensure broad semantic coverage and interpretability for scorecard defense.
